name: S.A.F. Special Steel Public Company Limited
summary: S.A.F. Special Steel Public Company Limited operates as a supplier of diverse steel products across Thailand. The company's comprehensive portfolio includes specialized tool steels, such as hot work, cold work, and plastic mold varieties, which are crucial for manufacturing molds and dies. They also provide various engineering steels, ranging from pre-hardened and carburizing types to general-purpose and wear-resistant grades. Beyond material sales, S.A.F. Special Steel offers precision vacuum hardening services and supplies finished components for industrial tooling and equipment. Their product line further extends to cutting solutions, featuring band saw blades and corresponding band sawing machines. Established in 1992, the firm maintains its headquarters in Bangkok, Thailand.
